description: Is this reading passage right for my learners? English text in: estimated CEFR band and audience, consensus grade, six readability formulas, vocabulary profile, long sentences, and concrete edits to reach a target level (target=A1..C2). PAID: 1 Iris Credit with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer iris_... header or the key argument; packs from $0.25, buyable with a plain USDC transfer, see payment_options), or $0.005 per call with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base) or MPP over MCP (USDC.e on Tempo). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected first; failed work is never charged (credits are refunded). Same result as GET /v1/text/level.

key.description: Optional Iris Credits key (iris_ + 48 hex). Better: set it once as the MCP header Authorization: Bearer <key>. Without a key the call is paid with x402 / MPP over MCP.

target.description: Optional CEFR level you want the text to be at; the answer then includes edits to get there.

text.description: English text, 30+ words, max 8000 characters (POST JSON {"text": ...} also works). Omit for a demo.
